aimeEncore.r1_t: He or she loves you, and it shows
aimeEncore.r1_d: Your answers describe someone who is there: they listen to you, seek you out, make plans with you and still touch you without thinking. The doubt you had probably comes from somewhere else. From a busy period, from an argument that left a mark, or from a need for reassurance that is your own.
aimeEncore.r1_a: Tell them what made you doubt, simply, without blame: "I was scared we were drifting apart". Someone who loves like that will be touched rather than annoyed. And if the need for reassurance comes back often, look at your side too: a fear of losing the other person makes even solid couples doubt.
aimeEncore.r2_t: Love is there, and so is routine
aimeEncore.r2_d: The big signs are all still present: plans, listening, making up after arguments. What has dropped is the everyday gestures, tenderness for no reason, the moments for two you no longer plan. It's the portrait of a couple that has settled in, not of a couple coming apart.
aimeEncore.r2_a: Don't ask the big question, suggest a small action: an evening for two this week, without phones. If the gestures come back as soon as you step out of daily life, you have your answer. And if you're the one doubting what makes you stay, the next question is the one about habit.
aimeEncore.r3_d: Your answers show a clear retreat: less time, less listening, plans that stay vague, and a tenderness that now only comes from you. It doesn't mean it's over. It means the bond no longer feeds itself, and that it's been going on long enough for you to have felt it.
aimeEncore.r3_a: It's time to talk about it, in a calm moment, talking about the two of you and not about their faults: "I feel like we're drifting apart, do you feel it too?". Their reaction will tell you a lot. If you'd rather take stock of the relationship itself first, look at where the relationship stands before the conversation.
aimeEncore.r4_t: The bond has come apart, and you already feel it
aimeEncore.r4_d: Almost all the signs are there: no more shared plans, no more listening, tenderness gone, and sometimes relief on their side when you're not there. You probably didn't need this test to know it. You needed to see it written down.
aimeEncore.r4_a: Don't stay alone with this. A frank conversation is needed, and it doesn't belong to you alone: he or she may have had something to say for a long time. If you're afraid of their reaction, or if you've been walking on eggshells for months, also look at whether you're still free in this relationship. Drifting apart sometimes hides something else.
aimeEncore.q1: When you get home in the evening, he or she…
aimeEncore.q1a: Looks up, kisses you, asks how it went.
aimeEncore.q1b: Says hello, smiles, then goes back to what they were doing.
aimeEncore.q2: The last "I love you" they said without you saying it first was…
aimeEncore.q2c: You're thinking… it's been a while.
aimeEncore.q3: You tell them about your day. They…
aimeEncore.q3a: Ask questions, react, want to hear the rest.
aimeEncore.q3b: Listen, a bit distracted at times.
aimeEncore.q3c: Half-listen, phone in the other hand.
aimeEncore.q3d: Cut it short, or change the subject.
aimeEncore.q4: Everyday tender gestures: a hand, a kiss in passing, a cuddle on the sofa…
aimeEncore.q4c: Rare, and it's almost always you making them.
aimeEncore.q5: When you talk about a plan six months or a year away, a holiday, a flat, a party…
aimeEncore.q5a: They talk about it with enthusiasm and add their own ideas.
aimeEncore.q5b: They go along, without getting excited.
aimeEncore.q5d: They avoid the subject, or say "I don't know where I'll be".
aimeEncore.q6: You're ill, or you've had a terrible day. They…
aimeEncore.q6a: Look after you, or worry from afar if you're not together.
aimeEncore.q6b: Ask if you're okay, and help if you ask.
aimeEncore.q6d: Almost hold it against you, as if it bothered them.
aimeEncore.q7a: They come back to you, you make up, you talk about it.
aimeEncore.q7b: It settles by itself, you carry on without talking about it.
aimeEncore.q7d: They leave the argument open, or use it to pull further away.
aimeEncore.q8: He or she looks at you…
aimeEncore.q8a: Still with desire, and tells you so.
aimeEncore.q8c: Rarely: you cross paths more than you see each other.
aimeEncore.q8d: You don't feel looked at anymore at all.
aimeEncore.q9: Their friends, their family, their colleagues: do you exist in what they tell them?
aimeEncore.q9a: Yes, you're in their stories, they take you everywhere.
aimeEncore.q9b: A little, when the occasion comes up.
aimeEncore.q9c: Less and less, you learn things after the fact.
aimeEncore.q9d: You feel kept out of their life.
aimeEncore.q10: When you suggest a moment for two, a restaurant, a walk, an evening…
aimeEncore.q10a: They say yes, or suggest something else.
aimeEncore.q10c: Often too tired, you put it off.
aimeEncore.q10d: Almost always no, or they find a reason.
aimeEncore.q11a: Present, with normal ups and downs.
aimeEncore.q11b: Less often, but always with gentleness.
aimeEncore.q11c: Almost gone, and they don't seem to miss it.
aimeEncore.q11d: They avoid any contact, or stiffen up.
aimeEncore.q12: They remember what matters to you: an important appointment, a worry, a wish you mentioned…
aimeEncore.q12a: Yes, and they bring it up again.
aimeEncore.q12b: Usually, with a reminder now and then.
aimeEncore.q12c: Rarely, you have to say everything again.
aimeEncore.q12d: No, as if what you say just slides off.
aimeEncore.q13a: They put it down and forget it.
aimeEncore.q13b: They often have it in hand, but answer when you speak.
aimeEncore.q13c: They're on it more than with you.
aimeEncore.q13d: They hide it, or close up when you come near.
aimeEncore.q14a: They tell you, they write to you.
aimeEncore.q14b: They show it in their own way.
aimeEncore.q14c: You don't know whether they miss you.
aimeEncore.q14d: They seem to do better when you're not there.
aimeEncore.q15: Their small attentions: a coffee, a message for no reason, something brought back for you…
aimeEncore.q15b: For occasions, and sometimes in between.
aimeEncore.q15c: Rare, you notice them precisely because they're rare.
aimeEncore.q16: You say "we need to talk about us". They…
aimeEncore.q16a: Sit down and listen, even if it's hard.
aimeEncore.q17: When you succeed at something, good news, a project that comes through…
aimeEncore.q17a: They're proud of you, say so, tell others.
aimeEncore.q17b: They congratulate you, then move on.
aimeEncore.q17d: They play it down, or don't mention it.
aimeEncore.q18: When they talk about the future, is it "we" or "I"?
aimeEncore.q18d: "I", and you're not in their plans.
aimeEncore.q19: An evening at home, just the two of you, nothing planned…
aimeEncore.q19a: You find each other again, even doing nothing.
aimeEncore.q19b: Each in your own corner, with moments together.
aimeEncore.q19d: They make sure not to be there, or go to bed early.
aimeEncore.q20: Deep down, if you had to answer without thinking: does he or she still love you?
aimeEncore.q20a: Yes, I'm sure, it's daily life that made me doubt.
aimeEncore.q20d: No. I think I already know.
